verdict.rationale: DeepInfra describes itself as an AI inference cloud. Asking whether a SaaS platform offers a self-hosted or on-prem version is a fair question, so the axis applies. The closest offerings are dedicated private-endpoint instances and rented GPU clusters with SSH access, but both still run on DeepInfra's own cloud. The evidence never shows the DeepInfra product being deployed on a customer's own infrastructure.
